# Third-party files

- `hanzi-writer.min.js` is Hanzi Writer v3.7.3 (https://hanziwriter.org), MIT licence, see `HANZI-WRITER-LICENSE.txt`.
- Stroke data is **not** stored in this repository. `tingxie.html` fetches one small JSON file per character from the `hanzi-writer-data` npm package (v2.0.1) through jsDelivr, then keeps it in the browser. That data comes from Make Me a Hanzi and is covered by the Arphic Public License (https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/blob/master/ARPHICPL.TXT).
